notes: Second dispatch, from commit 9fe732b. The first build (commit 898b046) completed, but its smoke test showed onnxruntime listing the MIGraphX provider and then falling back to the CPU because the Python wheel lacks libonnxruntime_providers_migraphx.so; 9fe732b links the native library into the wheel. Nothing native rebuilds: the Python onnxruntime package, keras, tf2onnx and faster-whisper rebuild, and the keras test suite (about 18 minutes) is the long pole. Activation is a separate, operator-approved step: make test-ser8 restarts Frigate on the GPU without changing the boot default. The GPU smoke test at /tmp/migraphx-smoke.sh on ser8 must print MIGraphXExecutionProvider in the session provider list before activation.
